arStrings.szText: Find {c_highlight}Slaughterhouse Keys{/c} in {icon:Marker_Helltide, 2.5} Helltide Zones and activate them to open a {c_highlight}Slaughterhouse{/c}.
In Slaughterhouses, become {c_highlight}the Butcher{/c} and wreak havoc by slaying guards and wanderers.
Earn {c_highlight}Fresh Meat{/c} to trade for {c_highlight}Bloodied Items{/c} at the Butcher Shop in Gea Kul.
